title: Fix a living-person date leak I introduced with the person graph
summary: tools/build_people.py decided whether to redact a person's dates by reusing really_living() from build_living.py — including its ancestor test. That test belongs in build_living.py, which lists living RELATIVES and rightly excludes ancestors. Reusing it for REDACTION was wrong, because ancestry has nothing to do with whether someone is alive.

The surname filter on /people was offering forenames.

title: Why the family left Arienzo: Forchia is an Annecchino town
summary: 681 Annecchino records harvested from the Benevento civil registers. They sort by town, and Forchia - where Carmine Falco was born in 1930 - is one of the two Annecchino strongholds.

title: Find the ship: Brisbane, 26 March 1964, per the Sydney from Naples
summary: NAA: K269, 26 MAR 1964 SYDNEY - the incoming passenger list, digitised in 42 pages - names four Falcos on the voyage: Carmine, Francesca, Giuseppina aged eight, and an Antonio who appears in no other record here. He is almost certainly Giuseppina's brother, and this is the first document to place him.
